sources.finding: Current Micro-DAX FDXS specifications state EUR 1 per index point. Distinct from FDAX and FDXM; futures have expiry and settlement rules.
sources.limitation: Current specifications do not establish every historical effective date or free five-minute coverage. No futures series was acquired.

sources.finding: DEU.IDX/EUR is listed as Germany 40 Index CFD. The table's definition of point uses the second decimal; it must not be mistaken for an entire index point.
sources.limitation: Historical lot sizes, all effective contract terms and target-period coverage remain unverified.

sources.finding: The stock-index CFD KID describes a product linked to current-period futures without its own expiry.
sources.limitation: A general KID does not establish a complete dated DEU.IDX/EUR execution specification or actual historical prices.

sources.finding: Free delayed pre/post-trade feed has 15-minute delay, minute updates and retention until midnight of the following business day; timestamps are UTC.
sources.limitation: This service is not a ready 2023-2026 archive. No ongoing collector authorized by this historical program was started.

sources.finding: The documented S3 historical-data route uses Requester Pays and requires valid AWS credentials.
sources.limitation: Not used because this program excludes paid data and credentials. This does not establish that all other Dukascopy routes are paid. No commands on this page were executed.

sources.finding: Text extraction did not expose export parameters. One visible browser navigation timed out; reading the same tab timed out on Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled.
sources.limitation: TOOL_ACCESS_UNRESOLVED, not a site denial or a negative history-availability finding. No export submitted, authentication used or second tab launched.

sources.finding: Official archive links historical calendars and year-end session notices including 2023 and 2024.
sources.limitation: Links are discovered evidence, not a normalized complete point-in-time session dataset. Color-coded calendar was not transcribed from incomplete text extraction.

sources.finding: Notice adds retail early trading 08:00-09:00 CET and late trading 17:30-22:00 CET.
sources.limitation: Additional trading phases must not silently redefine this model's first hour of the main session.

sources.finding: Official attachment specifies Xetra closing auction call at 14:00 CET, earliest price determination at 14:05, then trade-at-close until 14:15.
sources.limitation: These are distinct phases, not an interchangeable close price. Notice publication time was not verified. It is not yet an evaluator calendar row. PDF screenshot tool failed; the textual phase list was readable.
